name: nd-cse-degree-audit
description: ND CSE Degree Requirement Progress Checking — static self-check audit against the CSE Graduate Studies Handbook §3 (MSCSE) and §4 (Ph.D.)
//scripts-note: Tests run on node's built-in runner (node --test; Node >= 24 runs the TypeScript directly) — no test-framework dependency. The test script must name the files with a quoted glob: giving node --test a directory (tests/) fails on Node 24 with 'Cannot find module', which is what broke CI on Aug 31–Sep 1, 2026. Vite does the dev server and the production build. Never put a ':' in any parent folder name — it corrupts npm's PATH and breaks vite's module loader.
